body: Archer Aviation and ITA Airways have signed an agreement to partner on an electric air taxi network in Italy that could connect major airports with city centres using Archer's Midnight aircraft. ITA Airways, part of the Lufthansa Group, is the first European carrier to join Archer's international network of airline partners.

The companies will explore electric vertical takeoff and landing services in major Italian cities, with Rome among the potential locations. Archer says its Midnight aircraft could shorten journeys that now take 60 to 90 minutes by road to flights lasting 10 to 20 minutes, including a proposed connection between Rome Fiumicino (FCO) Airport and the city centre that could take less than 10 minutes by air compared with about an hour by car. ITA Airways will help develop the network by coordinating with aviation and transport stakeholders and exploring how air taxi services could connect with its existing operations; the carrier serves more than 70 destinations worldwide, and specialist partners would operate the aircraft. Midnight is designed for short journeys between airports and urban destinations and for frequent, consecutive flights, offering an alternative to road transport in congested metropolitan areas, and it produces no direct emissions during flight, although its overall environmental impact will depend partly on the electricity used to charge it. Archer recently conducted several days of piloted demonstration flights in California's San Francisco Bay Area, including flights between Oakland and San Francisco's Marina District that took about 10 minutes.

The ITA Airways agreement adds another airline to Archer's international partners, which already include United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, Japan Airlines, Korean Air and Ethiopian Airlines, and follows work with United on a proposed New York network, with Southwest at California airports, with Korean Air as an exclusive partner in South Korea, with Japan Airlines and Sumitomo Corporation's Soracle joint venture in Japan, and with Ethiopian Airlines under Archer's Launch Edition programme. Archer pointed to Italy's tourism market as an opportunity, noting that Rome Fiumicino crossed 50 million passengers last year for the first time. The proposed services will depend on obtaining the necessary regulatory approvals, finalising operating arrangements and building supporting infrastructure.
en.summary: Archer Aviation and ITA Airways have agreed to explore an electric air taxi network in Italy using Archer's Midnight aircraft, potentially cutting airport-to-city-centre trips such as Rome Fiumicino to under 10 minutes.
en.title: Archer and ITA Airways plan electric air taxi network in Italy

body: Archer航空與義大利航空已簽署協議，將合作在義大利打造電動空中計程車網絡，以Archer的Midnight飛機連結主要機場與市中心。隸屬漢莎集團的義大利航空，是第一家加入Archer國際航空公司合作網絡的歐洲航空公司。

雙方將探討在義大利主要城市提供電動垂直起降服務，羅馬是潛在地點之一。Archer表示，Midnight飛機可將目前需60至90分鐘車程的行程縮短為10至20分鐘的飛行，其中一項規劃是連結羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場與市中心，空中行程不到10分鐘，相較之下開車約需1小時。義大利航空將透過與航空與運輸利害關係人協調、並探討空中計程車服務如何銜接其現有營運，協助發展此網絡；該公司在全球服務70多個目的地，實際營運飛機的將是專業合作夥伴。Midnight專為機場與城市目的地之間的短程行程設計，可頻繁連續飛行，為壅塞都會區的公路運輸提供替代選擇，飛行時不產生直接排放，但整體環境影響部分取決於充電用電來源。Archer近期已在美國加州舊金山灣區進行多日有人駕駛示範飛行，包括奧克蘭至舊金山碼頭區約10分鐘的航程。

與義大利航空的協議讓Archer的國際合作夥伴再添一家，現有夥伴已包括聯合航空、西南航空、日本航空、大韓航空與衣索比亞航空；Archer先前也與聯合航空合作規劃紐約網絡、與西南航空合作加州機場航線、與大韓航空建立南韓獨家合作、與日本航空及住友商事合資公司Soracle合作日本服務，並與衣索比亞航空透過LaunchEdition計畫合作。Archer看好義大利旅遊市場，指出羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場去年首度突破5,000萬旅客人次。相關服務能否推出，仍取決於取得必要的監理核准、敲定營運安排並建置支援基礎設施。
zh.summary: Archer航空與義大利航空已達成協議，將探討以Midnight飛機在義大利打造電動空中計程車網絡，羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場至市中心的航程有望不到10分鐘。
